title: Python Basics
description: A complete beginner-to-solid-fundamentals path through Python — syntax, data structures, functions, files, and OOP essentials.

changelog.notes: Converted 2 cards ("self" naming convention, "PEP 8" style guide name) from typing types to tap-based select_blank -- typing cards should be reserved for cards whose answer is actual code/CLI syntax, not a definitional/naming-convention term.
Glossary: every term now points at one link, so the same word never sends you to two different pages.
Adds Learn more articles (20, each with a worked example) for the glossary terms; tapping a term now offers "Read the full explanation".
Removes the Wikipedia links from glossary terms that have a Learn more article; the article is now the single place to read more.
Rewrites the Learn more articles in a warmer, teacher-to-student voice; no change to the content or the glossary.
Cards and glossary: wrong-answer names such as downcase() and Maybe now have glossary entries and Learn more articles; broken code formatting fixed in several cards.
Cards: review fixes. Practice and pack cards now cover their planned keywords, and a few prompts, options and explanations no longer use terms taught later.
Removed five card pictures whose lettering was garbled.
Cards no longer point at the five removed pictures.
